hints.title: Blind Grid Exploration Traversal
hints.text: Exploring an unmapped room with unknown boundaries requires tracking relative visited coordinates and maintaining orientation discipline.

hints.title: Spiral Backtracking with Reversing Protocol
hints.text: From the current position, attempt to advance in each of four directions. After recursively cleaning an adjacent cell, retreat to the previous position and restore the original heading.

hints.title: Relative Coordinates Blueprint
hints.text: Directions: [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]. Mark (r, c) visited and clean. For i in range(4): nd = (d + i) % 4. Calculate neighbor coordinate. If not visited and robot.move(): recurse dfs(nr, nc, nd); go_back() [turn 180, move, turn 180]. Always turnRight() to maintain heading.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def cleanRoom(self, robot):
        directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
        visited = set()

        def go_back():
            robot.turnRight()
            robot.turnRight()
            robot.move()
            robot.turnRight()
            robot.turnRight()

        def dfs(r, c, d):
            visited.add((r, c))
            robot.clean()
            for i in range(4):
                nd = (d + i) % 4
                nr = r + directions[nd][0]
                nc = c + directions[nd][1]
                if (nr, nc) not in visited and robot.move():
                    dfs(nr, nc, nd)
                    go_back()
                robot.turnRight()

        dfs(0, 0, 0)
```

complexity.notes: Visits every reachable cell and backtracks once, making four turns at each location.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Random walks or uncoordinated exploration loops infinitely or leaves dead-ends unvisited.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited relative coordinate set avoids redundant exploration without room dimension foreknowledge.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct go_back physical retreat sequence that precisely restores robot orientation.
